interpretation: The hardened ontology is 1.75x LARGER than G_REC_DENSITY_V1 despite using 8 fewer primitives. The four new families contribute 12920 coordinates, of which C6/C7/C8 alone contribute 12852. Narrowing the primitive basis by 10% did not offset broadening the grammar from five families to nine.

instrumentation_density_audit.assessment: NOT materially reduced. The ECE share of the primitive basis falls only from 51.3% to 47.1%. The frozen conservative pairwise criterion defers 7 of 40 ECE channels. The stated motivation of preventing one diagnostic family from dominating the combinatorial weight is therefore only marginally served by the primitive-space component of this hardening; the grammar-broadening component is what changed substantially.

effective_rank_disagreement.explanation: The audit-only SVD summary suggests each redundancy-eligible group has a far lower linear effective rank than the number of representatives the frozen rule selected - ECE median rank 3 at 95% variance and 7 at 99%, against 33 representatives. The frozen pairwise criterion is deliberately conservative and PAIRWISE: it defers a channel only on a DIRECT witness with |r| stable in the worst 10% of discharge/block cells. Group-level low rank does not imply any particular PAIR meets that bar. Per the frozen policy the disagreement is recorded and NOT acted on; thresholds were not tuned.
effective_rank_disagreement.binding_threshold: R_10 >= 0.97 is what binds: 40 of 780 ECE pairs reach R_med >= 0.99, but 32 of those fail R_10 >= 0.97.
